notes: The chunk listed pages 4 and 5 as summary pages, but page 5 is the county's internal 'Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist' (two staff review sign-offs dated 5/18/2022), not a second report. ONE report only; page 4 is the sole Summary Page.

The schedule prints NO subtotal and NO total, so unlike every other side in this chunk there is no second independent anchor on the schedule itself — said loudly here rather than glossed. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 3488.45 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment, and never differenced against the filer's other report to synthesize anything.

expenditures.detail: 4 Schedule B rows sum to 724.84 + 26.53 + 97.50 + 16.08 = 864.95 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Expenditures Made = the promoted per-period Box D. (Running: 724.84 -> 751.37 -> 848.87 -> 864.95.) Box E YTD prints 3488.45 and is cumulative, never summed. The ladder closes: F 864.95 - D 864.95 = the printed Box G 0. itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and the pairing was read, not assumed: this is the newer 2022 blank with a per-row IN-KIND CHECKBOX column, and per ADDENDUM J1 the Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER as one block on every proof crop. All 30 checkboxes across the two grids are UNTICKED, and no cell carries an in-kind word or annotation, so both conventions give the same sums (864.95 / 864.95) and both close. Tested on this filing: the same filer's OTHER filing in this chunk (a14994b8) is on a different blank with no checkbox column at all, so nothing was carried between them.

itemized.notes: Taylor Williams, 2022 cycle, '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' (radio filled on p1); amendment answered 'No'; signed and filed 5/9/2022. Born-digital fillable modern_boxAF form, printed and scanned. THIS IS THE NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 BLANK (ADDENDUM J1) — verified on the page and materially different from the SAME FILER'S OWN EARLIER v. 4.20 report (key a14994b8) six weeks before: Schedule A's third column is 'CITY AND STATE' (not 'Address and Zip Code'), both schedules carry a per-row IN-KIND CHECKBOX column, the close box is LETTERED 'G', the cover offers SIX report types including 'End-of-Year Report', the affirmation block is headed 'Affirmation' (the v. 4.20 sheet mislabels it a second 'Type of Report'), the cover's date fields are 'Date' + 'Date of Filing' with NO Page/of foliation box anywhere, and the masthead rule is printed in colour. ONE FILER USED BOTH 2022 BLANKS SIX WEEKS APART — the J1 observation, confirmed again here. No version string is printed in the footer. pdfinfo: 6 pages, letter, ALL /Rotate 0 — read before measuring per K1. Pages classified BY CONTENT: p1 cover, p2 Schedule A, p3 Schedule B, p4 Summary Page, p5 CHECKLIST, p6 blank. ⚠ NEW SOURCE PROPERTY — A THIRD CHECKLIST REVISION EXISTS. ADDENDA J2/L4 record TWO checklist revisions (the plain one and the HOLD/#1/#2 one). The checklist bound at p5 here is NEITHER: its corner box offers only TWO options, 'Website' and 'Network', with NO 'HOLD' line; its title is set in black mixed-case ('Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist') rather than the all-caps blue of the other revision; its staff boxes are labelled plain 'Staff Signature' with no #1/#2; and its summary-page sub-items are worded differently ('Balance at Beginning of REPORTING PERIOD' and a final 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period' where the HOLD revision reads 'Balance at Beginning of Period' and 'POSITIVE balance at Close'). Both review copies on the sheet are dated 5/18/2022 — one signed in blue with a legible staff name, one in red — and BOTH corner boxes are unticked. That makes THREE revisions in the 2022 cycle alone, and it further weakens the 'revision is a date signal' idea already withdrawn in L4: this 5/18/22 review uses a layout the 4/4-4/6/22 reviews in this same chunk did not. ALSO: the summary page here sits at p4 and the checklist at p5, matching the common pattern, while the same filer's earlier report put the checklist at p9 of a duplex scan — the position is a property of the SCAN, not of the filing. ROW-INDEX TRAPS: all six screened, none present — first entry on band 1 on both schedules (crop-proved), no continuation lines, no voided rows, no banner, one-band-past controls empty on both pages, complete rule sets so no doubled band. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed — vendors in the Provider/Vendor column, purposes in the Purpose column, assignable by content. SUMMARY-BOX PAIRING SCREEN (L1): both sides carry the identical 864.95, so arithmetic alone cannot see a crossed pairing; the pairing is confirmed by CONTENT (Schedule A holds the candidate as a donor; Schedule B holds four service vendors) and by each sheet's printed heading. OBSERVATION, USED TO GATE NOTHING: Box C/E cumulative 3488.45 equals this report's 864.95 plus the 2623.50 stated on the same filer's 4/1/2022 report — noted only because it is the filer's own arithmetic and it is consistent; no figure here was derived by differencing or adding two covers, and each report was transcribed independently. PRIVACY: the county redacted the candidate's own address block on p1 (his signature is NOT redacted on this filing, unlike his earlier one — redaction is per-document and per-cell, ADDENDUM K4) and the single donor address cell on p2; only a bare zip survives there and no city was inferred from it.
